caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser featuring a top backboard with symmetrical scroll designs on each side, and four short legs. The dresser has two small drawers at the very top, side by side, each with a single central knob, and below them are four larger horizontal drawers, each with two round knobs. The wood is rendered in shades of brown and beige to suggest grain and texture, with darker brown used for the drawer fronts and legs, and lighter beige for the sides, knobs, and top. Decorative vertical grooves are illustrated on the legs. In the bottom right corner below the dresser is a drawing of a yellow and brown flower with multiple petals. The background is plain and uncolored, and the artist's signature, "Eva Wilson," is present near the flower.
title: Chest-Mahogany, Pine & Maple
